title.narrative: Output A.1. Enhanced decent work statistics using innovative sources and statistical standards

description.narrative: The Gambia Bureau of Statistics in collaboration with the Ministry of Trade, Industry,Regional Integration and Employment (MOTIE) has carried out a national Labour Force survey with a module on child labour in the first quarter of 2023 in accordance with the standards adopted by the International Conference of Labour Statisticians (19th and 20th ICLS). These include : - Resolution concerning statistics on labour, employment and the underutilization of manpower (19th ICLS); - Resolution concerning statistics on labour relations (20th ICLS); - Resolution to amend the resolution of the 18th ICLS concerning statistics on child labour (20th ICLS). The results of this survey were validated in August 2023 at a national workshop organized by The Gambia Bureau of Statistics (GBoS) in collaboration with MOTIE and tripartite partners. The national report and all survey data were shared with the ILO (ILOSTAT). The ILO provided technical support to the Gambia Bureau of Statistics in developing questionnaires in line with international standards in 2022. The ILO made a significant contribution to the processing and analysis of survey data between March and June 2023. The ILO also made a technical contribution to organizing the national workshop and reviewing the national report before its technical validation in August 2023.
